source: Official OSV querybatch API; package versions updated to the versions used for 3.9.1

findings.disposition: This old version is present in the archived npm development/test lockfile only. The APK and shipped editor bundle use the reviewed fixed 1.42.6 code.

compatibilityExceptions: Compose BOM and Lifecycle remain on the latest versions validated with compileSdk 36 and AGP 8.13.2; the newer stable line requires API 37 and a newer Android Gradle Plugin.
Vendored Nostr SDK/JNA binaries and Rust dependency set are unchanged from the reviewed 3.9 release; see SECURITY-REVIEW.md for native exposure notes.
limitations: The OSV batch is an advisory lookup, not proof that all components are free of vulnerabilities. Archived npm development/test alerts and native SDK exceptions remain documented.
